description: Set the coding conventions and verification commands (build, unit, integration, lint) that go into every task brief for this project. Tasks can override individual commands with their own verification. These are hints for the executor: the verifier never runs them. It runs only the checks a human configures in the Kanban UI (Verifiers tab), which the brief lists as verifier_checks.

verification_defaults.description: Verification commands keyed by kind, e.g. {"build": "dotnet build", "unit": "dotnet test tests/unit"}

name: set_execution_defaults
title: Set Execution Defaults
